budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Transport four complementary parcels to their bilateral private target depots by negotiating scarce expiring bridge access; choose toll revenue, prompt passage and reciprocal delivery assistance.
task.natural_termination: Terminate when all four unique parcels have been delivered. Otherwise truncate at 160; undelivered demands remain explicitly unsatisfied.
task.interaction: Each issuer must use the other bridge to cross; neither can issue itself a permit. A grant escrows a scarce real token and an action near a control point. Permits constrain entering the only river crossings. Toll quotes, expiry, physical congestion and complementary recipient rewards create cross-agent opportunities and costs.
task.observation_access: Public terrain and contract board includes wallets, requests, quotes, permit lifetimes, grants, expiries and receipts. Moving agents and active parcels have Manhattan-radius-3 visibility without wall occlusion. Each random delivery address is visible only to its original sender, named recipient and current carrier. Full-state debug views must be labeled separately.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public completed delivery notices by parcel
Public opposite-bank exits by carrier this tick
Public newly issued permit notices by bridge
Public expired unused permit notices by bridge
Fulfilled complementary demands by receiving agent

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
